file_too_big: file larger than {size} MB: it is not read
markup_too_big: document larger than {size} MB: HTML and RTF are parsed whole, so it is not read
rtf_too_deep: RTF with groups nested more than {depth} levels deep: it is not read
zip64: zip64 archive: far too large for a document
compression: unexpected compression method for a document
row_too_long: a row of more than {max} elements
outside_rows: more than {max} elements outside the rows
too_many_files: more than {max} files in the archive
xml_too_big: {size} of XML text once unzipped (at most {max})
